description: Download the full live odds board to a file on disk instead of returning it (it is too large for a context window). Provide an absolute save_path: a path ending in .gz keeps the gzip; any other path writes decompressed JSON. Pass include_history=true to include each selection's priceHistory (line-movement entries {fs,ls,pa,pd|dm,su?}; costs 5 credits flat instead of 1 — priceHistory is null without it). Returns the saved path, byte count and ETag. Re-poll cheaply by passing the returned etag: unchanged data returns not_modified without downloading (each variant has its own etag).

etag.description: Optional: the etag from a previous download. If the board hasn't changed the server returns 304 and nothing is downloaded.

include_history.description: true = populate every selection's priceHistory entries (5 credits flat vs 1). Identical schema either way — priceHistory is null when false.

save_path.description: Absolute file path to write the snapshot to. `.gz` suffix keeps it gzip-compressed; otherwise decompressed JSON is written.

name: download_snapshot
